cases.name: Debra Anne Stevens
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave said, "Mrs Stevens lived in Tuttle since Oct 1981. She was actively involved in many Tuttle school activities and also was a substitute teacher for the Tuttle school system. She was chairperson of the Peer Counseling Group for chemical people of Tuttle."
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; COLD CASE SOLVED; CONVICTION; EXECUTED
cases.narrative: On 5/6/1987, her nude body was discovered by her daughter in her family's home outside Tuttle, OK. She was found laying face-up with a small rope tied tightly around her neck, her hands bound tightly behind her with the same small gauge rope found around her neck, and white tissue or toilet paper stuffed in her mouth.
